doctrine: Color = cognition, not taste. Red is rationed — maruah is scarce by definition. One canon, two sensory modalities (human eye + agent parser).

yellow.rationale: Warmth. Yellow is the human-body color: sun, fire, light, life. Universal human warmth signal.

blue.rationale: Law. Blue is the institution color: banks, courts, constitutions, corporate trust.

teal.rationale: Geologic. Green-blue honestly mixed (teal → viridian → basin), not the 'Earth = green' cliché.

red.ration_rule: ONLY three surfaces: sovereign strip, verdict chips (888/HOLD/VOID), seals. Red elsewhere = design VOID.
red.rationale: Maruah is scarce by definition. If red is everywhere it means nothing.

500.use: VOID verdict only — the only red button
AAA cockpit only — single non-primer exception

amber.rationale: Reserved for the bridge. The only color that doesn't map to a scope.

primary.role: fill-on-paper only — illegal as text on paper (1.41:1); use yellow-900 #5C4500 for text on paper (8.51:1 AAA)
fill-on-paper OK at AA-large (9.68:1) when paired with ink
fill-on-paper only — illegal as text on paper (1.78:1); use teal-900 #064E3B for text on paper (9.08:1 AAA)

agentic.exception: ONLY non-primer accent. Do not introduce additional exceptions.

void.use: VOID verdicts, errors, hard floor breach — rationed

contrast_pairs.purpose: F2 TRUTH (real math) + F4 CLARITY (no architect-pleases-self lies). Lint blocks builds where text/fill combos fail this matrix.
contrast_pairs.rule_paper: On paper #FAF7F0: 500-series = fill/border ONLY. Body text uses ink #1A1A1A (16.27:1 AAA). Domain-tinted text uses 900-series (yellow) or 700-series (blue) or 900-series (teal caption-only).
contrast_pairs.rule_carbon: On carbon #101216: 500-series is legal as text (all pass 9-12:1 AAA). ink-inverse #FAF7F0 for body. muted-inverse #94A3B8 for captions.
contrast_pairs.rule_void_chip_on_carbon: Red-500 fill + paper-ink text. NEVER red text directly on carbon (4.50:1 borderline).
contrast_pairs.rule_muted: muted #5B6472 is CAPTION-ONLY (14px+, AA). Body text uses ink #1A1A1A. muted-inverse #94A3B8 for carbon captions.

muted #5B6472.verdict: AA — caption-only, exempt from AAA-body rule

yellow-500 #FFCC00 (light fill, human).verdict: AAA — dark ink on light yellow

teal-500 #00D4AA (light fill, earth).verdict: AAA — dark ink on light teal

blue-500 #1E3A8A (dark fill, institution.verdict: FAIL — dark ink on dark blue would be unreadable
blue-500 #1E3A8A (dark fill, institution.alt_verdict: AAA — paper-ink #FAF7F0 on dark blue (use this design)

blue-500 #1E3A8A.verdict: FAIL — do not use as text on carbon

red-500 #E63946 (rationed).verdict: AA-large — UI badges only, never body text

contrast_pairs.lint_enforcement: block build if any text/fill combination violates the matrix above; AAA rule applies to body text (16px+); AA rule for caption (14px+); AA-large rule (3:1) for UI badges and chip text

ink.use: default body text on light surfaces (16.27:1 AAA)

ink_inverse.use: default body text on dark surfaces (17.52:1 AAA)

muted.use: caption text on paper only (5.59:1 AA); caption-only, exempt from AAA-body rule

typography.scale_ratio: sqrt(2) — the octave of paper sizes (A-series fractal)

voices.human: IBM Plex Sans — body, h2, h3
voices.doctrine: IBM Plex Serif — display, h1, /laws, /arif/writings, doctrinal surfaces
voices.machine: IBM Plex Mono — caption, breadcrumbs, code, IDs, epistemic labels, state labels

rules.mono_use: structural, not stylistic — IDs, breadcrumbs, state labels, epistemic labels, JSON keys

typography.self_host: IBM Plex superfamily subsetted to Latin — served from web-canon, not Google Fonts

geometry.rationale: Doubling — same fractal pattern as the unit cell, expressed as spacing.
geometry.signature: Fractal corner-notch on every card. The unit cell is the brand.

torus.rule: Exactly ONE toroidal anchor per page.

types.trinity_ring: Three arcs around the AAA bridge center. Used on trinity tile rows.
types.mission_wheel: Concentric arcs representing the six missions. Used on /missions and mission-driven pages.

torus.violation: Two or more toroidal anchors on a single page = design VOID.

radius.rationale: 12 = tactile midpoint (organic but not soft). 2 = orthogonal precision (machine).

sharp.use: domain labels, code chips, ident tags

seal.name: SEAL — solid
seal.use: ratified actions, confirmed verdicts, primary CTAs

hold.name: HOLD — dashed border
hold.use: not yet ratified, awaiting sovereign, draft state

void.name: VOID — the only red button
void.rationale: 800ms = real preventer feel, like a circuit breaker. Prevents accidental destruction.

sovereign_strip.background: var(--blue-900) #0C1A45 — rationed dark blue (not red — strip is sovereign-but-lawful, not alarm)

breadcrumb.rule: disagreement between breadcrumb and URL = sentinel-firable

tombstone_render.frame: FULL universal frame with VOID verdict chip
tombstone_render.rationale: A sealed page, not an apology. The page knows it died and has been witnessed.

ci_lints.purpose: F4 Clarity enforced by pipeline, not by taste.

rules.name: contrast_minimum
rules.rule: every text/background pair must score >= WCAG AA (>= AAA for body text)

rules.name: red_ration
rules.rule: red (--red-500/700/900) only appears on: sovereign strip verdict chip, HOLD/VOID verdict chips, VAULT999 sealed chips, /arif sovereign anchor

rules.name: one_torus_per_page
rules.rule: no page renders more than one toroidal anchor

rules.name: torus_present
rules.rule: every page must include at least one toroidal anchor OR be explicitly marked as flat-surface (mission-driven pages may use Mission Wheel)

rules.name: single_skeleton
rules.rule: no font other than IBM Plex superfamily may be referenced in compiled CSS

agent_structural_translation.principle: One canon, two sensory modalities. Agent side is structural contrast, not visual contrast.

tactile.agent: state enum: rest | hold | sealed | void

agent_render_overrides.chrome: hairline rules, no shadows, no transforms
agent_render_overrides.density: tight (16-24px between blocks), tables preferred over cards, JSON blocks preferred over prose
agent_render_overrides.epistemic_labels: always visible as prefix tags (OBS/DER/INT/SPEC, CLAIM/PLAUSIBLE/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN)
agent_render_overrides.header: just scope name + version + last-updated ISO timestamp
agent_render_overrides.footer: monospace: vault:999  sealed:3847  last:2026-08-01T06:51Z  kernel:kanon-...  doctrine:v2.2
agent_render_overrides.json_ld: prominent in <head> AND inline at top of body for parseability

domain_to_token_mapping./arif: void-dark border on bare white — sovereign = absence of pattern
domain_to_token_mapping./laws: no domain accent + void-blue border — F1-F13 are world-edge

palette_zoning.doctrine: Two palettes, one canon, clearly zoned. GROUND is the wellhead; the scopes are the platforms. Without this line, the sentinel will eventually flag every organ page as a color violation, or worse, someone 'harmonizes' GROUND into trinity colors and kills it.

geology_voice.rationale: The sovereign voice. The earth first. The trinity becomes typographic (Sans/Serif/Mono), not chromatic. Red is rationed to the F13 pulse indicator alone. 4 colors total.
geology_voice.verdict: GEOLOGY — the wellhead. Sovereign authority. F13 signature.

territory_voice.palette: scope-family colors (yellow/blue/teal) + amber + bone + carbon + red-rationed
territory_voice.rationale: Wayfinding. Each scope speaks its own territory. HUMAN = yellow (warmth). INSTITUTION = blue (law). EARTH = teal (ground). Scopes are platforms off the wellhead.
territory_voice.verdict: TERRITORY — the platforms. Each scope carries its own voice via the 3 territory families.

shared_constants.red: #E63946 (rationed to sovereign-strip F13 indicator + verdict chips + seals ONLY; never text <12px; never on carbon-500 fill)

palette_zoning.lint_enforcement: scripts/canon-lint.js — asserts 4-color discipline, red ≥12px text, F13 pulse once-per-page, prefers-reduced-motion present. Run in CI on every PR touching canon/*

immutable: Primer colors only — no exceptions beyond the documented amber for AAA
Red ration — three surfaces only, enforced by CI
One torus per page — enforced by CI
IBM Plex only — no other fonts in compiled CSS
One canon, two render modes — same IA renders twice
PALETTE ZONING — root+/arif=geology, scope pages=territory. Two palettes, one canon. Enforced by canon-lint.
